title: Battle of Poznań (1704)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Poznań (1704)", at revision 1377988627, opens: "The Battle of Poznań took place on 19 August 1704 (N.S.) in Poznań, Poland during the Great Northern War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q562324, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1704 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
